exposure: severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 infection
cohort: 503 neonates born to 497 mothers diagnosed with COVID-19 during pregnancy or at the time of delivery in Spain
finding: Maternal COVID-19 infection did not significantly impact neonatal outcomes, and most neonates were managed with rooming-in, delayed cord clamping, and breastfeeding.
mod_finding: The study found a cesarean delivery rate of 33% among mothers with COVID-19.
